mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.0% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of UNRATE > 4.0% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for two consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month MA by >3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below its 12-month MA by >3% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both GDPC1 and HOUST below their 6-month moving averages signals broad-based weakness in housing and overall demand, which depresses consumer spending and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST are below their 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 3% coincident with a rise in CPIAUCSL above 3% signals a policy-lag environment where monetary easing fails to offset inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS < 3% and CPIAUCSL > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-month MA by >1% for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average by >1% for four months.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both GDPC1 and RSAFS above their 12-month moving averages by more than 2% signals strengthening aggregate demand and consumer balance sheets, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12-month MA by >2% AND RSAFS > 12-month MA by >2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages by >2%.
